{{Top|leg}}
The '''I2F-73''' series was the designation of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-equipped [[Industrial droid/Legends|industrial droids]] used as cargo transports by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Used to assist in the transport of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and other support units by [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], they worked along side the [[I2F-5]].
